name: verification-epistemics
description: Always-on epistemic discipline: don't act on an inherited, paraphrased, or prior-session claim without re-verifying it against current ground truth.

source.title: Verification Epistemics Baseline
source.relationship: Distilled from 2026-07 sessions (cross-repo Carrier/Luna investigation, ambiguous domain-term resolution, a stalled code trace, a misread alignment request) where trusting an inherited or paraphrased claim instead of re-verifying it against source produced a wrong conclusion.
